fallbackNotices: Scores for Sonnet 5.5, Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 include some component tasks served by a fallback model after a provider refusal; counting those as failures lowers them to 65.85%, 65.05% and 64.59% respectively, with the order unchanged. The split icon on each affected row itemizes them.
